title: Lake Louise, Moraine/Johnston Canyon, Emerald Lake, Hot Springs
blurb:
Embark on a full-day tour to witness the beauty of Canadian Rockies. Start your day with a pick-up from Calgary, Canmore, or Banff. Pass by Castle Mountain on your way to Lake Louise. In winter, experience an ice walk in the world-famous Johnston Canyon. Next, pass by the Vermillion Lake, visit the Upper Hot Spring, and stop in Banff Town. After a day of exploring, relax on the drive back to your starting point

Lake Louise: a glacial lake within Banff National Park. During winter, the lake exhibits breathtaking beauty, turning into a wonderland of ice and snow. You can enjoy ice skating on the lake

Johnston Canyon: The trail is open all year round, and in the winter, the frozen waterfalls and snow-covered paths are gorgeous. Crawl through the cave to see the iconic frozen waterfalls and pillars of blue ice

Upper Hot Springs: 100% natural mineral water running through them. Relaxing in the outdoor pool surrounded by the peaks of Rundle and Cascade Mountains is a fantastic experience
